g.text: General Search Unit: a cheap first step that picks the K history items most related to the target
Exact Search Unit: an expensive, trained step that attends over those K items
Search-based Interest Model (Alibaba, 2020): introduced the GSU → ESU split for long histories
GSU by same category tag (hard) or by similar learned ID embeddings (soft)
Kuaishou's lifelong models (2023, 2024): the GSU reuses the ESU's attention scores
Deep Interest Network (Alibaba, 2018): attention over the user's most recent items
attention where the candidate (target) item is the query and history items are keys
Mixture of Experts: shared experts with per-task gates, one output per task (CTR, CVR, …)
item–item similarity from co-clicks (Swing: users who clicked both items)
a user encoder and an item encoder whose dot product scores user–item pairs
a short tuple of discrete codes (c¹, c², c³) for an item, derived from its embedding
generative recommenders that predict semantic IDs (Google 2023, Kuaishou 2025)
Definitions in plain words; see the speaker notes for the papers behind each term
